result.topic_en: Pencil calculations of the logarithms of elliptic modular quantities (log k, log k', log K) expanded as series in q and evaluated as q approaches a root of unity (x = m/n·π), giving the limiting values as sums of fractional parts (Dedekind-sum-like expressions) with congruence conditions mod 2n, 4n, 8n.
result.transcription:
$\log k = \log 4 + \frac{1}{2}\log q + \sum (-1)^n \frac{q}{n} \frac{q^n}{1+q^n}$ , $q = e^{xi}$
$= i\left(\frac{x}{2} + \sum (-1)^{s} \frac{2}{s} \operatorname{tg} s\frac{x}{2}\right)$ $\quad x = \frac{2m}{n}\pi$ m ungerade[?]
$= i\left(\frac{x}{2} + \sum_{0,n-1,2n} (-1)^s \frac{2}{2nt+s} \operatorname{tg}\frac{sm}{n}\pi\right) = i\frac{x}{2} + 2i\int_0^1 \sum_{1,2n}^{s} (-1)^s \operatorname{tg}\frac{sm}{n}\pi \frac{x^{s-1}dx}{1-x^{2n}} + i\frac{x}{2} + 2\int_0^1 \sum_{1,2n}^{t} (-1)^s \frac{\alpha^{2ms}-1}{\alpha^{2ms}+1} \frac{1}{2n} \frac{\sum \alpha^{t} x^{t} dx}{1-\alpha^t x}$ $\quad \alpha = e^{\frac{2\pi i}{2n}}$
$\frac{1}{1+r^{2m}} = \sum (-1)^{\sigma} \frac{r^{2m\sigma}}{1-r^{2n}} = -\frac{1}{2n}\sum_{0,2n-1} \sigma \alpha^{2\sigma m}$ $= i\frac{x}{2} + \frac{1}{2n}\int_0^1 \frac{\sum \alpha^t dx}{1-\alpha^t x} 2\sum \sum (-1)^{s+\sigma} \alpha^{s(2m\sigma+\sigma)-t}$
$2m(1+\sigma)-t+n \equiv 0 \mod 2n$ $\quad = i\frac{x}{2} + 2\sum_{1,n-1} \log(1-\alpha^{n+2m\sigma})(-1)^{\sigma}$
$= i\frac{x}{2} + 2\pi i\left(\sum_{1,n-1} \frac{2m\sigma}{2n}(-1)^{\sigma} - \sum_{1,n-1}(-1)^{\sigma}\,\mathcal{E}\left(\frac{2m\sigma}{2n}+\frac{1}{2}\right)\right)$ $\quad = i\frac{x}{2} + \sum_{1,n-1}\log \alpha^{2m\sigma}(-1)^{\sigma}$
$x = \frac{m}{n}\pi$ m ungerade
$\log k = -\frac{q}{q-q_0} \frac{\pi^2}{n^2} \sum \frac{1}{2n} + \sum \frac{2}{st} \frac{st+1}{st} [-(1-(-1)^{st})-] = A + \frac{x}{2}i + 2\int_0^1 \sum \frac{\alpha^t x^t dx}{1-\alpha^t x} \frac{1}{2n} \sum (-1)^{t} \alpha^{-t\sigma}$ $\alpha = e^{\frac{2\pi i}{4n}}$
$= \frac{q+q_0}{q-q_0} \frac{\pi^2}{2n^2} \sum \frac{1}{2n} - \frac{1}{n}\log\frac{1+q^n}{1-q^n}$ [-...-] $\quad + \frac{x}{2}i + 2\int_0^1 \sum_{1,4n} (-1)^s \frac{x^{s-1}}{1-x^{4n}} \operatorname{tg}\frac{sm}{4n} \frac{\alpha^{2ms}-1}{\alpha^{2ms}+1}$
[-$\frac{x}{2}i + 2\int_0^1 \frac{\sum x^t dx}{1-\alpha^t x}$-] $\quad \sum \sum (-1)^{s+\sigma} \sigma \alpha^{2s\sigma m}(\alpha^{2ms}-1)\alpha^{-st}$
$= A + \frac{x}{2}i + 2\int_0^1 \sum_{1,4n}^{t} \frac{\alpha^t dx}{1-\alpha^t x} \frac{1}{4n} \frac{1}{2n} \sum_{1,4n-1}\sum_{0,2n-1} (-1)^{s+\sigma}\sigma\,\alpha^{2s\sigma m}(\alpha^{2ms}-1)\alpha^{-st}$
$= A + \frac{x}{2}i + 2\cdot 2\pi i \sum_{1,n-1} \frac{s}{n}(-1)^{s}\left(\frac{ms-n}{2n} - \mathcal{E}\frac{ms}{2n}\right)$ , $m\mu \equiv 1 \mod 2n$
$= A + \pi i\left(\frac{m-\mu}{2} + \frac{\mu}{2n} + 2\sum_{1,n-1} \mathcal{E}\frac{ms}{2n}(-1)^{s} - 2\sum \frac{ms}{2n}(-1)^{s}\right)$
$x = \frac{m}{2n}\pi$, m ungerade
$\log k = \frac{q+q_0}{q-q_0} \frac{\pi^2}{8n^2}\sum \frac{1}{2n} + \frac{1}{2n}\log\frac{1+q^{2n}}{1-q^{2n}} + \frac{x}{2}i + \sum_{1,8n-1}\sum (-1)^s \frac{2}{8nt+s}\operatorname{tg}\frac{s m\pi}{8n} = A + \frac{x}{2}i + 2\int_0^1 \sum_{0,1,8n} \frac{x^{s-1}dx}{1-x^{8n}} \frac{\alpha^{2ms}-1}{\alpha^{2ms}+1}(-1)^s$
$= A + \frac{x}{2}i + 2\int_0^1 \sum_{1,8n}^{t} \frac{x^t dx}{1-\alpha^t x} \frac{1}{8n}\cdot\frac{1}{4n}\sum_{1,8n-1}\sum_{0,4n-1}(-1)^{s+\sigma}\sigma\,\alpha^{2s\sigma m}(\alpha^{2ms}-1)\alpha^{-st}$ , $t \equiv 2\sigma m + 4n \mod 8n$
$= A + \frac{x}{2}i + 2\sum_{1,4n-1}\log(1-\alpha^{4n+2m\sigma})\frac{1}{8n}\cdot\frac{1}{4n}\left(8n(-1)^{\sigma}(\sigma-1) - (-1)^{\sigma} + 8n(-1)^{\sigma}(2n-1)\right)$ $\quad \sigma \equiv r-1 \mod$
$= A + \frac{x}{2}i + 2\sum_{1,2n-1}\log(1-\alpha^{2\sigma m})\frac{\sigma}{2n}(-1)^{\sigma} = A + \frac{x}{2}i - 4\sum_{0,2n-1}\log(-\alpha^{2\sigma m})\frac{\sigma}{4n}(-1)^{\sigma}$ $\quad = A + \frac{x}{2}i - 4\sum_{0,2n-1}\left(\frac{\sigma m}{2n}\right)\left(\frac{s}{4n}\right)(-1)^{\sigma}\cdot 2\pi i$
$-\log k' = 8\sum \frac{q^t}{t(1-q^{2t})} = 4i\sum\frac{1}{t\sin tx}$, $q = e^{xi}$, $\frac{1}{1-r\alpha^{2ms}} = \sum_{0,2n-1}\frac{r^{\sigma}\alpha^{2ms\sigma}}{1-r^{2n}}$, $\frac{1}{1-\alpha^{2ms}} = -\frac{1}{2n}\sum_{0,2n-1}\sigma\alpha^{2ms\sigma}$ $\quad t = \frac{m(2r+1)}{4n} \mod 4n$
$x = \frac{m}{2n}\pi$, m ungerade $\quad \sum\sum \alpha^{ms(2\sigma+1)} \alpha^{-ts}$
$-\log k' = 4i\sum_{0,1,4n-1}\sum \frac{1}{4nt+s}\frac{1}{\sin\frac{ms\pi}{2n}} = 8\int_0^1 \sum \frac{x^{s-1}dx}{1-x^{4n}}\frac{\alpha^{ms}}{1-\alpha^{2ms}} = 8\int_0^1\sum_{1,4n}\frac{\alpha^t dx}{1-\alpha^t x}\cdot\frac{1}{4n}\cdot\frac{1}{2n}\sum_{1,4n-1}\sum_{0,2n-1}$
$2n\,(r-?)$ $\quad 2\sum_{0,n-1}[\log(1-\alpha^{m(2r+1)}) - \log(1-\alpha^{m(2r+1)})] = 2\sum_{0,n-1}\left(\frac{m(2r+1)}{4n} - \frac{1}{2}\right)2\pi i$ $\quad \frac{\pi}{2}\sum\frac{m(2r+1)}{4n}$
$= 8\sum_{0,2n-1}\log(1-\alpha^{m(2r+1)})\frac{1}{4n}\cdot\frac{1}{2n}$ $\quad = 4\pi i\sum_{0,n-1}\left(\frac{m(2r+1)}{4n} - \frac{1}{2}\right) - 4\pi i\sum_{0,n-1}\frac{r}{2}$
$= \pi i\left((m-2)n - 4\sum_{0,n-1}\mathcal{E}\left(\frac{m(2s+1)}{4n}\right)\right)$
$x = \frac{m\pi}{n}$, m ungerade $\quad x\sum\frac{q^t}{t^2} \quad \alpha = e^{\frac{2\pi i}{2n}}$ $\quad \frac{\alpha^t}{t^2}$
$\log k' = -\frac{q+q_0}{q-q_0}\frac{\pi^2}{4n^2}\cdot q_0^{n} + 8\int_0^1\sum_{1,2n-1}\frac{x^{s-1}dx}{1-x^{2n}}\frac{\alpha^{ms}}{1-\alpha^{2ms}} = A + x\int_0^1\sum_{1,2n-1}\frac{x^t dx}{1-\alpha^t x}\cdot\frac{1}{2n}\sum_{1,2n-1}\sum_{0,n-1}\left(\frac{\sigma}{n}\right)\alpha^{ms(2\sigma+1)}\alpha^{-ts}$ $\quad t \equiv m(2r+1) \mod$ $\quad (t \equiv m(2r+1)+n)$
$= A + 8\sum_{0,n-1}\log(1-\alpha^{m(2r+1)})\cdot\frac{1}{2n}\left(\frac{r-\frac{n-1}{2}}{n}\right)n - 8\sum_{0,n-1}\log(1-\alpha^{m(2r+1)+n})\cdot\frac{1}{2n}\left(\frac{r-\frac{n-1}{2}}{n}\right)$
$= A + 8\sum_{1,\frac{n-1}{2}}\frac{1}{2n}\left(\frac{s}{n}\right)\left(\log(1-\alpha^{2ms+mn}) - \log(1-\alpha^{-2ms+mn})\right) - 4\sum\left(\frac{s}{n}\right)\left(\log(1-\alpha^{2ms+(n+1)n}) - \log(1-\alpha^{-2ms+(n+1)n})\right)$
$= A + 8\pi i\sum_{1,\frac{n-1}{2}}\left(\frac{s}{n}\right)\left(\left(\frac{2ms+(n+1)n}{2n}\right) - \left(\frac{2ms+mn}{2n}\right)\right) = A + 4\pi i\sum\left(\frac{s}{n}\right)(\quad) = A + 4\pi i\sum\left(\frac{\mu s}{n}\right)\left(\left(\frac{2s+(n+1)n}{2n}\right) - \left(\frac{2s+mn}{2n}\right)\right)$ $\quad m\mu \equiv 1 \mod n$
$\quad = A + 4\pi i(-1)^{m+1}\sum_{1,\frac{n-1}{2}}\left(\frac{\mu s}{n}\right)$
$= (-1)^{m+1}\left(\frac{\pi^2}{4n^2}\frac{q+q_0}{q-q_0} + \pi i\left(\frac{n^2-1}{n}\mu - 4\sum_{1,\frac{n-1}{2}}\mathcal{E}\left(\frac{\mu s}{n}+\frac{1}{2}\right)\right)\right)$
$\log\frac{2K}{\pi} = 4\sum\frac{q^t}{t(1+q^{2t})} = \log\frac{q_0+q}{q_0-q} + 4\sum\frac{1}{t}\left(\frac{q^t}{1+q^{2t}} - \frac{1}{2}\frac{q^t}{q_0^t}\right) = \log\frac{q_0+q}{q_0-q} + 2i\sum\frac{1}{t}\operatorname{tg}t\frac{x}{2}$ , $\alpha = e^{\frac{2\pi i}{2n}}$ $\quad \frac{1}{1+r^{2n}} = \sum_{0,n-1}\frac{(-1)^{\sigma}r^{\sigma}\alpha^{2\sigma m}}{1+r^{n}}$
$x = \frac{2m}{n}\pi$, m ungerade $\quad \sum_{1,n-1}(-1)^{\sigma}\alpha^{2\sigma m}$
$\log\frac{2K}{\pi} = \log\frac{q_0+q}{q_0-q} + 2\sum_{1,2n-1}\frac{1}{2nt+s}\frac{\alpha^{ms}-1}{\alpha^{ms}+1} = \log\frac{q_0+q}{q_0-q} + 2\int_0^1\sum_{1,2n}\frac{\alpha^t dx}{1-\alpha^t x} - \frac{1}{2n}\sum_{1,2n-1}\sum_{0,n-1}(-1)^{\sigma}\sigma\,\alpha^{2s\sigma m}(\alpha^{2sm}-1)\alpha^{-ts}$ $\quad = A + \frac{1}{2}\sum\left(\frac{rm}{n}-\frac{1}{2}\right)(-1)^{r}2\pi i - \frac{1}{2}\sum\left(\frac{m}{n}\right)(-1)^{r}\pi i$
$= \log\frac{q_0+q}{q_0-q} + 2\sum_{1,n-1}\log(1-\alpha^{2rm})(-1)^{r}\frac{1}{2n}\cdot n - 2\sum_{1,n-1}\log(1-\alpha^{2rm+n})(-1)^{r}\cdot\frac{r}{2n}\cdot n$
$= \log\frac{q_0+q}{q_0-q} + 2\pi i\sum_{1,\frac{n-1}{2}}\left(\left(\frac{2m}{n}+\frac{1}{2}\right) - \left(\frac{2m}{n}\right)\right)$ $\quad (\alpha^{ms}-1)\alpha^{-ts}$, $t \equiv 2m\sigma$ mod $\quad t \equiv 2m\sigma - 2n$
$x = \frac{m}{n}\pi$, m ungerade $\quad \alpha = e^{\frac{2\pi i}{4n}}$
$\log\frac{2K}{\pi} = \frac{q+q_0}{q-q_0}\frac{\pi^2}{4n^2} + \log\frac{q+q_0}{q_0-q} + 2\sum_{1,4n-1}\frac{1}{4nt+s}\frac{\alpha^{2ms}-1}{\alpha^{2ms}+1} = A + 2\int_0^1\sum_{1,4n}\frac{\alpha^t dx}{1-\alpha^t x}\frac{1}{4n}\cdot\frac{1}{2n}\sum_{1,4n-1}\sum_{1,2n-1}(-1)^{\sigma}\sigma\,\alpha^{2ms\sigma}(\alpha^{2ms}-1)\alpha^{-ts}$
$= A + 2\int_0^1\sum_{1,4n}\frac{\alpha^t dx}{1-\alpha^t x}\frac{1}{4n}\cdot\frac{1}{2n}\sum_{1,4n-1}\sum_{1,2n-1}(-1)^{\sigma}\left(\frac{\sigma-n}{2n}\right)\alpha^{2ms\sigma}\alpha^{-ts} = A - 2\sum_{1,2n-1}\log(1-\alpha^{2rm})\frac{1}{4n}(-1)^{r}\left(\frac{r-n}{2n}\right)4n + 2\sum\log(1-\alpha^{2rm+2n})(-1)^{r}\left(\frac{r-n}{2n}\right)$
$= A - 2\pi i\sum_{1,2n-1}(-1)^{r}\left(\left(\frac{mr+n}{2n}\right) - \left(\frac{mr}{2n}\right)\right)\frac{r-n}{2n} = A - 2\pi i\sum_{1,2n-1}(-1)^{r}\left(\left(\frac{mr+n}{2n}\right) - \frac{r}{2n}\right)\left(\frac{\mu s-n}{2n}\right) = A + 2\pi i\sum_{1,n-1}(-1)^{r}\left(\frac{\mu s-n}{2n}\right)$ $\quad m\mu \equiv 1 \mod 2n$
$\quad = A + 2\sum_{1,2n-1}\sum_{0,n-1}(-1)^{\sigma}\left(\frac{\sigma-2m}{4n}\right)\alpha^{ms\sigma}\alpha^{-ts} = A + 2\pi i\sum_{1,2n-1}(-1)^{r}\left(\frac{\mu r-2m}{4n}\right)$ $\quad m\mu \equiv 1 \mod 4n$
$x = \frac{m\pi}{2n}$, m ungerade
$\log\frac{2K}{\pi} = \log\frac{q_0+q}{q_0-q} + 2\sum_{1,8n-1}\frac{1}{8nt+s}\frac{\alpha^{ms}-1}{\alpha^{ms}+1} = A + 2\int_0^1\sum_{1,8n-1}\frac{\alpha^t x^t}{1-\alpha^t x}\frac{1}{8n}\cdot\frac{1}{4n}\sum_{1,8n-1}\sum_{0,4n-1}$
